_comment: What each weekday produces, in IST. The GitHub Actions cron decides WHICH days actually run; this file decides what a run makes. The cron currently fires Mon, Tue, Wed, Fri, Sat, so the live week is 3 reels, 1 carousel and 1 image. Thursday and Sunday are rest days and their entries here are only used if you trigger a run by hand on those days. Reels also go to YouTube as Shorts.

reel._why: Completion rate is the ranking signal on both Shorts and Reels, and 20 to 30 second videos retain over 80 percent where 50 second ones lose most viewers. Measured delivery is about 2 narration words a second including pauses, so the word budget in the writer prompt is derived from these numbers. Raise them only with retention data in hand.
